mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses risk-free discount rates, increasing the present value of equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals strengthening labor market conditions that elevate corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in >50% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous residential construction expansion (HOUST > 1700) and consumer spending growth (RSAFS > 600000) signal robust aggregate demand, elevating corporate profit margins and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST > 1700 and RSAFS > 600000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.3% monthly indicates manufacturing supply chain recovery, increasing corporate output volumes and profit expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >50% of instances when INDPRO growth > 0.3% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 265.0 index level signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 265.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 105.0 index level indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output volumes and profit expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment decline below 5.0% and payroll growth exceeding 0.3% monthly signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and corporate costs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.3% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 0.5% quarterly signals late-cycle economic expansion that fuels corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in >50% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
